final_message:
The yen receipt now renders as `Paid ¥500 by card`, and all 18 tests pass.

The cause was in `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divided every amount by 100, which is wrong for yen because yen has no minor unit. I added a zero-decimal currency set containing `JPY`, and those amounts are now printed as they are.

`formatMoney` is shared, so JPY amounts in invoice lines (`src/invoices/render.js`) and cart totals (`src/cart/total.js`) change too. They had the same bug, and no other tests use JPY. If any of those paths store yen amounts multiplied by 100, they would need a separate fix.
